title: CmdPal: Run list item icon blinks as the query changes

judgment.rationale: The report has concrete reproduction and existing upstream ownership. Preserve the covering candidate and validate the reported behavior and its controls rather than create a competing implementation or request an unnecessary diagnostics archive.
judgment.recommended_action: Review and verify the existing open candidate51920; retain this issue until a confirmed repair is available.
evidence: The0.102 report affects both the home Run fallback and Run page as a query changes; the timeline links open51920.
The candidate uses shell icon requests for known existing targets, retains the same effective icon across argument edits and provides a generic fallback for missing targets.
It also guards latest-query publication and temporarily clears old context-menu commands while rebuilding; those changes require overlap/argument controls, not just an icon screenshot.
Added tests exercise icon stability, missing/quoted paths, real target changes and preservation of an already-published command argument snapshot.

prerequisites: Use the built-in Run provider with an installed notepad/cmd target; compare baseline and candidate without changing user icon customizations.
reproduce.expected_result: Stable targets do not blink, real target changes update the icon, and no older overlapping query or context menu overwrites the latest command.
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported0.102 baseline and the pinned candidate for PR51920
steps: On home fallback and Run page type cmd /c echo one, then edit only arguments; watch for icon flicker and count icon changes.
Change cmd to notepad; try an unresolved command, URI, folder, and quoted existing path to check shell/generic fallback selection.
Overlap a slow and fast query, invoke the retained previous command object, and check that the latest row/menu shows only its current arguments.
Run FallbackExecuteItemTests, FileItemTests, ParseCommandlineTests and affected RunPageTests on the candidate.
